## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · devx seat 2 · 2026-10-27T05:02Z

Seat `domain:devx#2` (#20163) · `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9` · reviewed head `35440f1d` · card #26443 (claim 6433712787, branch `claude/project-thread-6wlskb`), wave 10 delta O, the devx half. Not governed (`check-governed-merges`: tier null); +386/−47, no workflow touched.

- **The reader:** `scripts/ci-shard-matrix.mjs` reads `ci.yml` as text (attestation runs in install-free jobs; the partitioner needs the count synchronously at load). It understands the two shapes ci.yml uses, a literal `[1..N]` and the planned `fromJSON(… || '[1..N]')` whose size is the full-roster fallback. It refuses everything else and has no default, which is the right call: a remembered N is the drift being removed. Locally on the head: `--self-test` exit 0 (27 cases, 5 batteries; live test=8, dogfood=3, test-ui=16).
- **Callers:** `partition-test-shards.mjs`'s `SHARD_COUNT` is now the matrix itself, so its old matrix-vs-constant self-test check becomes a sanity check, and the remaining read-backs (`--shard N/M`, attestation `--total`) stay. `partition-test-shards --self-test` exit 0 locally (8 shards). The `check-required-contexts` (9) anchor and the `check-shard-attestation` live-name, grow/shrink and #26084 fixtures build their strings from the live size, and keep the `form === 'planned'` assertion so a shape change still reds loudly. Every other importer of `partition-test-shards` names it only in comments, so the load-time read reaches no install-free or sparse context. Those two self-tests exit 3 here (no `node_modules` in the seat container, NOT MEASURED); the PR's Lint jobs are their verdict.
- **Deviations, accepted:** the reader sits at `scripts/` rather than `scripts/lib/` because `check:pm-dispatch-gates` read the multi-segment specifier as a watch hint and dropped the partitioner's dependents; this is a measured reason. The acceptance grep still shows 105 hits, classified in the PR body as comments, replays of past runs at their own width, synthetic fixtures and CLI slice labels; none copies the live matrix. `check-expected-skips.mjs` (the roster child's) and `select-shard-timings-run.mjs`'s matcher default are untouched, as scoped.
- **Left for `domain:ui`:** `ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:54` and `select-affected-tests.test.ts:450–453` still spell `/16`; they can call `shardTotal(text, 'test-ui')`. Routed to the ui lane; this card stays open for it (`Part of #26443`).

Landing: ready + auto-merge once CI on this head is green.
